Package io.vanslog.spring.data.meilisearch.core

Class SearchResponseMetadata

java.lang.Object
io.vanslog.spring.data.meilisearch.core.SearchResponseMetadata
public final class SearchResponseMetadata extends Object
Metadata for one Meilisearch search response, including its position in a flattened multi-search result.

  • Constructor Details

    • SearchResponseMetadata

      public SearchResponseMetadata(int queryIndex, int firstHitIndex, int hitCount, @Nullable Integer processingTimeMs, @Nullable String query, @Nullable String indexUid, @Nullable Long totalHits, @Nullable Long estimatedTotalHits, @Nullable Integer page, @Nullable Integer hitsPerPage, @Nullable Integer totalPages, @Nullable Integer offset, @Nullable Integer limit, @Nullable Map<String,Object> facetDistribution, @Nullable Map<String,Object> facetStats, @Nullable Map<String,Object> facetsByIndex)
      Creates a response snapshot without inferring absent wire fields. Nested facet maps and lists are copied into unmodifiable structures.
      Parameters:
      queryIndex - zero-based response position in the request
      firstHitIndex - zero-based start of this response's hits in the flattened result, including empty spans
      hitCount - number of loaded hits associated with this response
      processingTimeMs - captured processing time in milliseconds, or null
      query - captured query text, or null
      indexUid - captured index uid, or null
      totalHits - exact matching-hit count, or null when not reported
      estimatedTotalHits - estimated matching-hit count, or null when not reported
      page - one-based page number, or null when not reported
      hitsPerPage - requested page size returned by the server, or null
      totalPages - reported page count, or null
      offset - zero-based result-window offset, or null
      limit - reported result-window limit, or null
      facetDistribution - response-level facet value counts, or null
      facetStats - response-level numeric facet bounds, or null
      facetsByIndex - per-index facet distributions and statistics, or null
